subject: Migrate dict.c unit tests to new framework (#946)
reason: The change only migrates dict.c's unit tests from the legacy SERVER_TEST in-binary test runner to the new standalone unit-test framework (new src/unit/test_dict.c, removal of the #ifdef SERVER_TEST block in dict.c, its prototype in dict.h, and the 'dict' entry in server.c's serverTests table). All removed code was compiled only when SERVER_TEST is defined and the added code is test-only; no server runtime behaviour, command reply, data structure logic, replication or persistence path is altered, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario against a real server could exercise.
